provenance.all_z_tiling: BCFW v3 Theorem 13.3; standard case also ELT BCFW triangulation theorem
provenance.relation_space: Indicators of closed tile regions modulo semialgebraic sets of dimension < 8
provenance.zero_insertion: Selecting increasing rows from any positive Z yields a positive row submatrix

certification_argument: Standard KWZ collections and their dihedral transforms tile for every positive Z.
Subtract their two indicator equalities and cancel common tiles.
For insertion, apply the source relation to the positive increasing row submatrix of Z.
Source-parent incidence is checked separately by vanishing-minor support inclusion.
limitation: Relations built from equal-cardinality complete BCFW collections are balanced by construction.
